matter_register: Seven qubits, 128 basis states: native pair indices 0..99, separate matter vacuum 100, invalid padding 101..127.
record_register: One logical qubit with the optical record-block encoding supplied separately; matter and record vacuum are distinct factors.
native_inputs: All four chirality/doublet cases in native_spinor_pair_adapter.json; v=J(1,0,0,1)/sqrt(2), J=W tensor conjugate(W).
basis_change: Extend v by zeros on vacuum/padding. For w=e0-v, alpha=1-v0, U=I-w wdagger/alpha; native v0 is real and alpha nonzero. U=Udagger=U^-1 and U e0=v. This is a declared synthesized gate, not a native cycle word.
interaction: Sort by Udagger, compute selected primary/rival predicate reversibly into a clean flag, apply exp(+i theta X_record) conditioned on flag, uncompute flag, unsort by U. theta=g*delta_model_time. No measurement of matter or flag.
record_dynamics: Record occupation N_record remains a separate noncommuting term. Full exact record block evolution may instead multiplex active exp[-it(N_record-gX)] versus inactive exp[-it N_record]; do not multiply these exponentials as if N and X commute.
source_K: Reuse the frozen selected K only under its already checked self-adjointness and commutation with c and Pi; its own simulator gate implementation is separate from this control interface.
vacuum_policy: Both interaction controls zero on matter vacuum and padding. Record gap still acts on record excitations there; common empty reference retained.
hardware_capabilities_required: coherent state-preparation/basis-change circuit for supplied v
reversible seven-bit equality/range predicates with clean ancilla
controlled record rotations or controlled exact record-block unitaries
faithful native K simulation and record-gap control
logical-to-optical record interface if optical implementation is selected
